title: Leaf-cutter ant mounds resembling a Mesoamerican city at La Venta

tellings.quote: I was in Mexico. I was I was at this ch site called Lventa. I'm standing at at the base of the Great Pyramid of Lamenta

plain: A researcher who goes by Luke Caverns tells of a visit to La Venta, an ancient site in Mexico with a large earthen pyramid. He says that while standing at the base of that pyramid he noticed mounds built by leaf-cutter ants that looked like a small version of an ancient Mexican city. He offers it as part of his idea that the pyramids are not what people think they are.
